categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the manufacturing and sales of stainless steel pipes and stainless steel coils. It also produces stainless steel angle steel and provides contract processing services. The business focuses on high value-added stainless steel products including structural and piping stainless steel pipes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes such as online polishing for round and square pipes, online annealing, and automated cutting systems. It continuously improves production technology and product quality by introducing advanced domestic and international equipment and molds, and invests in research and development for new materials and production techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industries such as machinery manufacturing, transportation, construction, petrochemical, food processing, paper, and chemical industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports primarily to the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Domestic customers number in the thousands, and overseas markets cover over a hundred countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Yunlin County and sales offices in northern and southern Taiwan. The company has subsidiaries and production facilities in mainland China (Suzhou, Wuxi), Africa, Samoa, and Morocco, supporting global market coverage including Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the stainless steel supply chain, focusing on processing stainless steel coils into pipes and related products. It sources raw materials primarily from domestic and international stainless steel coil suppliers and supplies finished products to various industrial sectors downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high value-added product lines, enhancing production efficiency, and reducing costs through process improvements. R&D focuses on process development, product quality enhancement, new product development such as titanium pipes, and advanced welding technologies. The company also emphasizes talent development and automation to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of stainless steel pipes, coils, and related products. The company also earns income from contract processing services. Sales are diversified across domestic and international markets to mitigate risks.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the domestic market include Yung Chyang and Ta Chen Stainless Pipe Co., Ltd. The company holds a significant market share in Taiwan’s welded stainless steel pipe sector and is recognized for its comprehensive product range, strong R&D capabilities, and high product quality certifications, positioning it as a leading player in the industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues around NT$12.4 billion with a slight decline compared to the previous year, but improved profitability with operating margins increasing from 7% to 10%. It has a stable asset base exceeding NT$12 billion and equity of approximately NT$5 billion, showing steady growth and improved financial performance in recent years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through a complete product line that meets diverse customer needs, advanced manufacturing technologies that enhance product quality and production efficiency, and strong quality assurance certifications including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, JIS, and TUV. Its global sales network and ability to develop customized, high value-added products provide competitive advantages and high customer satisfaction.
